agreementText:
FICTIONAL QA AGREEMENT - no real client data.
C1. A responsive five-page website and a contact form with name, email, message and an inbox notification are included.
C2. Calendar synchronization is explicitly excluded.
C3. One round of minor updates is included. Minor is not defined.
C4. Agreed fee USD 1500; estimate 20 hours; delivery November 22, 2026.
C5. The gallery caption is "Ready 🚀". The approved footer caption is also "Ready 🚀".
C6. A proposal alone does not change the agreement.
